# Synthetic TNTP fixture

Invented rows in the TNTP file schema (4 nodes, 5 links, 3 zones). No row comes from any real dataset. Used only by `tests/test_tntp.py`. The reference flow file is an arbitrary flow vector for parser tests, not an equilibrium.
